# discord_managed_server (Resource)

Manages settings of an existing Discord server (guild). Does not create or delete the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_local_image" "icon" {
  file = "${path.module}/assets/icon.png"
}

data "discord_local_image" "splash" {
  file = "${path.module}/assets/splash.png"
}

resource "discord_managed_server" "example" {
  server_id       = var.server_id
  name            = "Example Server"
  icon_data_uri   = data.discord_local_image.icon.data_uri
  splash_data_uri = data.discord_local_image.splash.data_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The server name (2-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The ID of the existing server to manage.

### Optional

- `default_message_notifications` (Number) Default notification level: 0 = all messages, 1 = only mentions.
- `description` (String) The server description (for Community servers).
- `explicit_content_filter` (Number) Explicit content filter level: 0 = disabled, 1 = members without roles, 2 = all members.
- `icon_data_uri` (String) Server icon data URI, for example discord_local_image.data_uri.
- `splash_data_uri` (String) Invite splash data URI, for example discord_local_image.data_uri. Requires the INVITE_SPLASH feature.
- `verification_level` (Number) Verification level: 0 = none, 1 = low, 2 = medium, 3 = high, 4 = very high.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as server_id.
